title: Future Restrictions of Inner Automorphic Dilations
exact_target: Restrict a minimal inner dilation to its future module, extend that future dynamics, and embed it compatibly into the original dilation.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001185 (OWR-3392-013). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

status_qualification: Retain the restriction, extension, and unital compatible embedding as separate requirements, including the proposed two-sided q-Fock case study. The source notes that the embedding would correspond to a module factorization E=E_+ tensor F; it is not assumed.
